package.description: Package folder the plugin infers, passed as --package-path

product.description: Executable product the plugin infers from swift package describe

entitlements.description: Entitlements file <product>.entitlements beside the target sources, signed into the product where present

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Install
description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release, signs a copy under the Apple Development identity with the hardened runtime, and renames it over ~/.local/bin/<product>, the per-user folder launchd's PATH holds
